channel.title: BlackBerry — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by BlackBerry (blackberry).

item.title: CVE-2026-50077 · 7.7 HIGH — Vulnerabilities in the QNX Virtual Machine (QVM) affect QNX Hypervisor and QNX Hypervisor for Safety
item.description: Invalid Memory Access via the MSI-X table in QVM could allow an attacker in the guest to execute arbitrary code in the QVM to cause memory corruption, information disclosure or a crash of the QVM.

item.title: CVE-2026-50078 · 4.4 MEDIUM — Vulnerabilities in the QNX Virtual Machine (QVM) affect QNX Hypervisor and QNX Hypervisor for Safety
item.description: Out-Of-Bounds Read in the MSI-X table in the QVM could allow an attacker in the guest to cause an information disclosure or a crash of the QVM.

item.title: CVE-2026-50079 · 3.3 LOW — Vulnerabilities in the QNX Virtual Machine (QVM) affect QNX Hypervisor and QNX Hypervisor for Safety
item.description: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition in the virtio network virtual device could allow an attacker in the guest to manipulate the virtual network device causing a crash of the QVM.

item.title: CVE-2026-50080 · 3.3 LOW — Vulnerabilities in the QNX Virtual Machine (QVM) affect QNX Hypervisor and QNX Hypervisor for Safety
item.description: Stack-based Buffer Overflow in the ACPI event handler of the QVM could allow an attacker in a guest to crash the QVM by sending a crafted ACPI request.

item.title: CVE-2026-40273 · 4 MEDIUM — Vulnerabilities in the QNX Neutrino kernel affect QNX Software Development Platform and QNX OS for Safety
item.description: Improper Input Validation in a procnto message handler could allow an attacker with local access to send a crafted message which can cause an information disclosure in the QNX Neutrino kernel

item.title: CVE-2026-40274 · 4 MEDIUM — Vulnerabilities in the QNX Neutrino kernel affect QNX Software Development Platform and QNX OS for Safety
item.description: Invalid Pointer Reference in the TimerSettime() system call could allow an attacker with local access to arm a crafted timer event which can cause an information disclosure in the QNX Neutrino kernel.

item.title: CVE-2026-40275 · 8.4 HIGH — Vulnerabilities in the QNX Neutrino kernel affect QNX Software Development Platform and QNX OS for Safety
item.description: Heap-based Buffer Overflow in the DCMD_PROC_EVENT handler of the procnto could allow an attacker with local access to cause an information disclosure, data tampering or a crash of the QNX Neutrino kernel.

item.title: CVE-2026-54436 · 7.4 HIGH — Vulnerabilities in the QNX io-char library Impacts QNX Software Development Platform
item.description: Heap-based Buffer Overflow in the io-char library's DCMD_CHR_WAITINFO devctl() handler could allow an attacker with local access to cause data tampering, arbitrary code execution, or a crash in the Character I/O device driver.

item.title: CVE-2026-54437 · 6.2 MEDIUM — Vulnerabilities in the QNX io-char library Impacts QNX Software Development Platform
item.description: Improper Input Validation in the io-char library's DCMD_CHR_TCINJECTC devctl() handler could allow an attacker with local access to cause data tampering in the memory input buffer of the Character I/O device driver.

item.title: CVE-2026-18247 · 5.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting in BlackBerry AtHoc Web Portals
item.description: A Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Web Portals of AtHoc IWS in versions earlier than 7.21 HF-734 could allow an attacker to potentially execute actions in the context of the victim's session.

item.title: CVE-2026-40272 · 7 HIGH — Vulnerability in the QNX libtraceparser Impacts QNX Software Development Platform
item.description: Improper Input Validation in the decode() function of the traceparser library could allow an attacker with a corrupted kernel trace event log (.kev) file, to execute arbitrary code or cause a crash in processes that use libtraceparser in QNX hosts or…

item.title: CVE-2026-18084 · 8.6 HIGH 🌩️ — Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Management Console of BlackBerry UEM
item.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation vulnerability in BlackBerry UEM Management Console of BlackBerry UEM allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects UEM: 12.23.0 QF8 or earlier.

item.title: CVE-2026-18085 · 5.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Improper Input Validation Leads to Arbitrary File Download and Potential Denial of Service in BlackBerry UEM
item.description: An Improper Input Validation in the BlackBerry UEM Management Console of BlackBerry UEM 12.23.0 QF8 and earlier allows Arbitrary File Download and Potential Denial of Service.

item.title: CVE-2026-4018 · 6.4 MEDIUM — TOCTOU race condition in the QNX Neutrino kernel impacts versions of the QNX Software Development Platform and QNX OS for Safety
item.description: TOCTOU Race Condition in specific trace commands of the TraceEvent() system call could allow an attacker with local access and with the PROCMGR_AID_TRACE ability, to cause information disclosure, data tampering or a crash of the QNX Neutrino kernel.

item.title: CVE-2026-4017 · 7.4 HIGH — Buffer overflow in the QNX Neutrino kernel impacts versions of the QNX Software Development Platform and QNX OS for Safety
item.description: Buffer Overflow in the entry handler of the TraceEvent() system call could allow an attacker with local access to cause information disclosure, data tampering or a crash of the QNX Neutrino kernel.

item.title: CVE-2026-0515 · 6.2 MEDIUM — Insufficient parameter validation in the QNX Neutrino kernel impacts versions of the QNX Software Development Platform and QNX OS for Safety
item.description: Insufficient Parameter Validation in the SchedGet() system call could allow an attacker with local access to cause a crash of the QNX Neutrino kernel.

item.title: CVE-2025-8090 · 6.2 MEDIUM — Vulnerability in the QNX Neutrino Kernel impacts the QNX Software Development Platform and QNX OS for Safety
item.description: Null pointer dereference in the MsgRegisterEvent() system call could allow an attacker with local access and code execution abilities to crash the QNX Neutrino kernel.
